Hi Oliver / Sofia -

Thanks again for the time today. Great conversation - high level takeaways and proposed next steps below.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: customer-facing semantic search + chat for support + personalized summaries.
- Volume: ~30M monthly queries, 99th pct latency target ~250ms for short-L2 responses.
- Security/regulatory: SOC2 + VPC option required, customer data must remain in their region.

Proposed next steps to keep momentum:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to confirm success criteria and procurement path - ~30m.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our SE (Vivek) to validate latency/cost tradeoffs and integration approach - ~60m.
3) Share mutual action plan and rough timeline (attached).

Availability - are any of these windows good for the exec intro next week?
- Tue 6/22 10:00-10:30am PT
- Wed 6/23 1:00-1:30pm PT
- Thu 6/24 11:00-11:30am PT

If those don't work, send a couple options and we'll align. I copied Rafael in case you want to route contracting questions to him during the exec call.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf (MVP POA), redwood_product_onepager.pdf

Thanks - look forward to locking in the next call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
